commands.detail: 520 packages audited; 3 moderate dependency audit findings
all seed/session/card/lifecycle/form validations and Vite build passed
9/9; primitives 10; public 18; routes 12; responsive 6; UI Lab screenshots 21
5/5; Admin 30; states 5; non-Admin 11; public 18; layout 30; accessibility 5
3/3; Client responsive 18; interactions 3 groups; non-Client 8; public 18; browser errors 0
generated Prisma Client 7.8.0 before backend type/build

notes: Round 3 and Round 4 validators explicitly disable approved descendant styles while measuring their original layer contracts.
Round 6 validator permits Client product changes only on approved Round 7+ descendants while continuing to reject backend, API, Worker, and Shell changes.

Public regression disables animation in audit context and compares stable DOM, computed color/background/border/radius, bounding boxes, auth-off state, and overflow with Client CSS enabled and disabled.

Round 1-6 browser audits were run in an isolated temporary worktree and their generated artifacts were restored between validators; Round 7 was rerun on redo/r07-client-dashboard because its branch guard intentionally rejects temporary branch names.
The first backend type check after npm ci failed because generated Prisma client files were absent; prisma generate restored the documented build prerequisite, after which type and build passed.
No production database or production API mutation test was executed.
